meta.title: About
meta.description: ItalBridge Partners is one accountable partner between Italian industrial manufacturers and buyers in Kenya and East Africa, based in Nairobi.

hero.title: One accountable partner between Italian industry and East Africa.
hero.text: ItalBridge Partners connects Italian industrial manufacturers with qualified buyers in Kenya and East Africa — and carries every deal from first requirement to after-sales.
hero.caption: Our base: Nairobi, serving six East African markets.

why.title: Why we exist.
paragraphs: Italian manufacturers build some of the world's best industrial equipment, but selling into East Africa usually means opening an office, finding local partners and managing a long chain of intermediaries.
East African buyers want that equipment — but need someone on the ground who understands the specification, the contract, the shipment and the service that follows.
why.conclusion: We sit in the middle as a single accountable partner, so both sides deal with one team from start to finish.

items.title: A local presence in Nairobi
items.text: On the ground, in the buyer's time zone, able to visit sites and meet teams in person.

items.title: Direct Italian relationships
items.text: We work directly with manufacturers, not through chains of agents.

items.title: End-to-end coordination
items.text: From sourcing through commissioning, one team owns every stage.

items.title: Technical and commercial support
items.text: We read specifications and negotiate contracts — both sides of the deal.

items.title: Cross-cultural expertise
items.text: Fluent in Italian and East African business cultures, expectations and practice.

items.title: After-sales coordination
items.text: We stay involved after delivery — installation, spares and service.
